unit.why: An anecdote about R. Shimon, moreh tzedek of Vilna, a non-Hasidic rabbinic authority, who rushed at night to correct a halakhic ruling; it is followed by a homiletic explanation.
unit.boundary_note: The division ends with a homiletic gloss and a source citation (מנ"י). The next division begins a new teaching.

stories.start_quote: וקבלתי מעשה מהרב ר׳ שמעון מ״ץ מווילנא
stories.summary_en: R. Shimon, moreh tzedek of Vilna, realized he had erred in a ruling on the seven clean days. He went through Vilna's streets at midnight to tell the woman she must count again, explaining to his complaining servant that he might die in the night and be left with a sin he could not mend.

tags.why: Praises the scrupulous piety of a non-Hasidic Vilna rabbinic authority
